fusions.name: Flock Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 3 feathers in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. Their damage rises 8% for each ally within 5 tiles (max 32%).

fusions.name: Warning Cry
fusions.desc: Strikes from a height for 26 damage, up to 1.8 times that at the full 9 tiles. If it hits, every ally near you strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Brooding Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Insulating Down
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
